sha256:2dba7e6fcb6f2db39b52cc2902abfb80d.description: Initial saved_complete input only. Resume state is guest-root owned and is never accepted by this external input contract. Text is limited to 60 KiB; up to two PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF data URLs are accepted within a 3 MiB encoded input budget enforced separately.

action_approval_mode.description: Captured turn preference only. Independent native Host policy is required for execution authority; omission means ask.

strategy_maximum_cost_microusd.description: Optional lower per-turn strategy limit in integer micro-USD. The Host always enforces its own one-dollar ceiling.

strategy_reference.description: Exact provider instance of an admitted AI strategy Pack. Missing or disabled selected providers fail closed.

thinking_level.description: Requested model reasoning level. The Host validates this finite value and binds it to the saved AI call.
